skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply macroeconomic theories to analyze and evaluate the impact of macroeconomic policies and shocks on short-term and long-term economic variables.
Use macroeconomic models effectively to synthesize and analyze economic issues and policies.
Develop independent research skills to enhance understanding of advanced macroeconomic issues.
Work collaboratively in teams to solve complex macroeconomic problems.
Improve critical thinking abilities to analyze and critique macroeconomic issues and policies at national and local levels.
Enhance presentation skills to communicate knowledge through writing, discussion, and problem-solving.
